what_to_detect: The resolution of a cycling ability, whose acting line is the bare Cycling keyword line (script API type Keyword, no Draw API), holds a card_drawn event for its controller.
near_miss: A cycling resolution that drew no card.

what_to_detect: An untap turn_action in which a tapped land with a non-mana activated ability (such as cycling) does not untap while a restricting static applies, so its untapped event is absent.
near_miss: An untap turn_action in which a land without any non-mana activated ability untaps.

what_to_detect: The resolution of a typecycling ability, whose acting line is the TypeCycling keyword line (script API type Keyword, not ChangeZone), holds a zone_change from library to hand for a card of the named type.
near_miss: A typecycling resolution whose search found no card of the type, with no zone_change from library to hand.
